title: Capability domains the executive should pursue autonomously
operator_note: The agent must not acquire email, phone, wallet, or bank access without explicit human provisioning into the vault. This file defines what to want and how to ask — not permission to self-signup with stolen identity.

trust_ladder.name: discover_and_document
trust_ladder.agent_may: Research free tiers, APIs, ToS; log candidates; draft operator requests

trust_ladder.name: dedicated_identity
trust_ladder.agent_may: Use operator-provisioned accounts (agent-only email/phone) via approved tools

trust_ladder.name: sign_and_send
trust_ladder.agent_may: Send email/SMS, sign messages with provisioned keys — with rate limits and audit

trust_ladder.name: value_movement
trust_ladder.agent_may: Crypto/fiat only with human-approved policies, separate vault entries, verifiers on outbound tx

domains.label: Outbound email (agent identity)
discovery: Research: Cloudflare Email Routing + Workers, Resend free tier, SendGrid trial, Migadu, agent-only Gmail/Outlook forward
domains.operator_deliverable: Dedicated address (e.g. agent@yourdomain) + SMTP/API creds in vault
examples: Password-reset flows you cannot complete alone

domains.label: Inbound email (read/parsing)
discovery: IMAP OAuth apps, Cloudflare forwarding to webhook, minimal inbox for 2FA mails
domains.operator_deliverable: Read-only mailbox or forward-to-webhook; never the operator's personal inbox

domains.label: Phone number / SMS
discovery: Twilio trial, Telnyx, Vonage, UK: compare virtual number + SMS API; some LLM APIs require phone verify — prefer operator-owned number
domains.operator_deliverable: Agent-only virtual number; SMS webhook or API key in vault

domains.label: Voice / OTP relay (last resort)
discovery: Same vendors as SMS; document when voice required
domains.operator_deliverable: Explicit opt-in; log every OTP request in audit
examples: Banking or gov ID flows — usually human-only

domains.label: Crypto wallet (non-custodial or API)
discovery: Chain-specific: hot wallet key in vault vs custodial API (Coinbase Commerce read-only vs signing)
domains.operator_deliverable: Separate wallet with spend caps; never co-mingle with human savings
never_automate: Signing mainnet txs without human-approved policy + verifier

domains.label: Bank / fiat payments
discovery: Open banking (UK/EU) where available; business-only accounts; virtual cards with limits
domains.operator_deliverable: Separate business account or virtual card; hard spending ceiling; human merge for policy changes
examples: Eventually: pay cloud invoices within budget

domains.label: API egress via worker/proxy (IP & region)
discovery: docs/AGENT_ARCHITECTURE_IDEAS.md — forward proxy, regional exit, cache GETs, mTLS brain→body→API
domains.operator_deliverable: Optional: approve a body/VPS as outbound proxy; allowlist target hostnames
never_automate: IP rotation to evade abuse bans or ToS
